subject: Web Development
title: Real User Monitoring
description: A 1-minute de-risking session on Real User Monitoring.

hook.text: Lab tests show what could happen. Real User Monitoring shows what actually happened.

buildup.text: RUM collects performance data from every real page visit, across all devices and networks.

discovery.text: You see p50, p75, and p99 latencies — revealing how the slowest users actually experience your site.

twist.text: The p99 is often 10x slower than the median. The worst experience matters most.

climax.text: RUM turns performance from a guess into a science with real data from real users.

punchline.text: Real users show you what tests can't.
